items.title: Security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source (Unauthenticated Customer Account Takeover)
items.summary: This update resolves critical vulnerabilities, including an unauthenticated customer account takeover (CVSS 9.1) that could lead to arbitrary code execution, security feature bypass, and privilege escalation. Exploitation attempts were observed shortly after disclosure.

items.title: Security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: Adobe released a security update addressing critical and important vulnerabilities that could lead to security feature bypass, privilege escalation, arbitrary file system read, and application denial-of-service. Adobe is not aware of any exploits in the wild for these issues.

items.title: Security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This bulletin addresses critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including unrestricted file upload (CVE-2026-48356), improper output encoding (CVE-2026-48358) leading to arbitrary code execution, stored XSS (CVE-2026-47994), and incorrect authorization issues (CVE-2026-47988, CVE-2026-47984). Successful exploitation could lead to arbitrary code execution, security feature bypass, and privilege escalation.

items.title: Unauthenticated file upload in Amasty Order Attributes for Magento
items.summary: A critical (CVSS 9.3) unauthenticated arbitrary file upload vulnerability in Amasty Order Attributes allows attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without logging in, leading to remote code execution. Amasty released a fix in version 4.0.0.

items.title: Critical vulnerability in Mirasvit Cache Warmer for Magento
items.summary: Sansec discovered a critical (CVSS 9.8) unauthenticated PHP object injection vulnerability in Mirasvit Cache Warmer, a Magento extension, which can lead to remote code execution via a crafted cookie. Mirasvit released a patched version (1.11.12) on May 25, 2026.

items.title: Adobe Commerce Auth Bypass Vulnerability
items.summary: This is an Incorrect Authorization vulnerability (CVSS 7.5) affecting multiple Adobe Commerce versions, allowing a remote, unauthenticated attacker to bypass security checks and gain unauthorized write access. No user interaction is required for exploitation.

items.title: Unrestricted file upload in Magento and Adobe Commerce REST API
items.summary: Sansec discovered PolyShell, a critical flaw in Magento's REST API that enables unauthenticated attackers to upload executable files disguised as images. Adobe released a fix in Magento 2.4.9 on May 12, 2026, but older supported versions remained vulnerable without backports.
